scope.interpretation_summary: The Oral Biologics Market encompasses products that are biologically derived and administered orally, including therapeutic proteins and peptides. Key participants include manufacturers, distributors, and service provide
scope.market_definition: The Oral Biologics Market encompasses products that are biologically derived and administered orally, including therapeutic proteins and peptides. Key participants include manufacturers, distributors, and service providers operating on a global scale.

value_chain_layers.description: This layer involves the production of oral biologics, including the formulation and packaging of biologically derived products.
This layer includes the distribution and wholesale of oral biologics to healthcare providers and pharmacies.
This layer includes companies that provide services related to the distribution and integration of oral biologics.
This layer includes various partners that facilitate the marketing and sales of oral biologics.

  Business Solutions
  
  Our businesses bring together leading technologies, innovative solutions and hands-on expertise to
  support the entire healthcare ecosystem.

  All Businesses Listings
  
  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced

bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

**What We Do**

### Built to serve
### the full ecosystem

California Life Sciences is the state’s most influential advocacy and membership organization,
advancing bold science, supporting entrepreneurs, and building the life sciences ecosystem for more
than 30 years.

From established industry leaders to early-stage startups, CLS supports organizations of every size
across biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, and medical technology, with advocacy, programs, and
community that fuel progress.

#### Advocacy Leads Here

We work at every level of government to ensure California remains the most supportive environment
for life sciences growth and innovation.

**[Learn More →][35]**

#### Support Starts Here

We support our members through programs and the partnerships they need to grow, navigate challenges,
and move innovation forward.

**[Learn More →][36]**

#### Innovation Thrives Here

We design and deliver high-impact programs that help life sciences companies grow, lead, and
innovate across California.

**[Learn More →][37]**

#### Connections Grow Here

We convene the people, ideas, and conversations that shape the future of life sciences through
in-person and virtual gatherings.

**[Learn More →][38]**

###### Welcome to Evologics

# Committed.

***Evologics***  is a surgical biologics distributor focused on human tissue allografts and related
products. We work with physicians, hospitals, and surgical centers to provide access to products for
surgical applications consistent with their official labeling and regulatory status.

***Evologics*** is proud to partner with industry leaders that have created and practice only the
highest bone and tissue sterilization processes. Using processes like PASCO2^{®}, our products are
sterilized while preserving biologic integrity, ensuring only high-quality bone, tissue and
allografts.

[ DOWNLOAD CATALOG ][68]

###### Our Values

## Safety, innovation and service.

###### 01.

##### Safety

Guided by our core values of accountability, precision, and transparency, we foster a culture where
safety is everyone’s priority. We are committed to protecting the health and well-being of patients,
partners, and communities by ensuring the highest standards of safety across every aspect of our
operations.

###### 02.

##### Innovation

We make lives better by combining our product innovations with compassion, ensuring healthcare
providers receive only the best products for their patients. By embracing cutting-edge technology
and creativity, we aim to improve patient outcomes, and create new standards in safety and standard
of care.

###### 03.

##### Service

We deliver exceptional service that consistently exceeds expectations, forging long-lasting, strong
relationships with our partners. We are dedicated to fostering trust, reliability, collaboration and
responsiveness with every interaction, empowering healthcare providers while improving patient
outcomes.

###### Our Products

## Committed to Quality

Evologics offers a wide array of products, including amnion, soft tissue allografts, bone and more
for a wide array of specialties, including spine, orthopedics, sports medicine, ophthalmology,
cosmetic surgery, podiatry and wound care.

##### EvoPatch Amnion

Minimally Manipulated Amniotic Tissue that can be used in open incision, laparoscopy and/or robotic
surgery procedures

##### Demineralized Bone Matrix

Available in multiple sizes to address a a wide array of procedures, including foot and ankle,
trauma and extremities, knees, hips, craniomaxillofacial, spine and more.

##### DBM Fiber

Demineralized cortical bone fibers that are entangled and shaped into sizes engineered to complement
specific surgical applications.

##### Bone and Tendon Allografts

Hard and soft allografts in a variety of configurations for most surgical applications.

###### Our Purpose

*“At Evologics, we understand successful business depends on a successful team. With the perfect
team, we continue to strive for excellence, providing healthcare professionals with products that
make people live better, healthier lives. We care more – and that’s what makes the difference.”*

Michael Crescenzo

# Who We Are

At Med-X Surgical Distribution, our vision is to revolutionize healthcare by providing comprehensive
high-quality medical solutions that enhance patient care and support healthcare professionals.

Founded in 2015, Med-X Surgical Distribution began as a specialized distributor of spinal and
cranial implants and biologics. Recognizing the evolving needs of the healthcare industry, we
expanded our offerings to include a wide range of medical and surgical disposables. Our commitment
to quality and compliance led us to become FDA-registered and an approved U.S. government vendor,
enabling us to serve various government and healthcare agencies with reliable medical supplies.

At Med-X Surgical Distribution, we take pride in offering a comprehensive and diverse product
portfolio designed to meet the ever-evolving needs of healthcare providers. While our company has
significantly expanded over the years, we remain firmly rooted as one of the leading distributors of
spinal and cranial implants as well as biologics, proudly representing over 25 world-renowned
manufacturers worldwide.
In addition to our core expertise in spinal and cranial implants and biologics, we have broadened
our offerings to include our own proprietary line of surgical instruments and retractors, adult
incontinence care products, medical and surgical disposables, advanced wound care solutions, and
cutting-edge regenerative medicine. Our portfolio also encompasses state-of-the-art capital
equipment and durable medical equipment, ensuring we provide solutions for a wide range of medical
and surgical needs.

To further support healthcare providers, we have established strategic partnerships with multiple
Group Purchasing Organizations including NuEdge Alliance LLC., Vizient and Provista to offer the
most competitive pricing to hospitals and healthcare facilities. These partnerships are a testament
to our dedication to ensuring cost-effective access to premium-quality medical products and
solutions.

By maintaining our leadership in spinal, cranial and biologics distribution while diversifying into
other areas, Med-X Surgical Distribution has positioned itself as a trusted and comprehensive
partner for our healthcare providers. Whether it’s delivering groundbreaking implants and biologics
or reliable surgical disposables, our mission is to ensure that every healthcare professional has
access to the highest-quality tools and supplies necessary to provide exceptional patient care.

As we continue to grow, we remain focused on providing innovative, premium-quality medical products
and services that empower healthcare professionals to deliver the highest standards of care for
their patients.

Platinum Biologics products are obtained from healthy, carefully screened mothers at the time of
normal delivery. In addition to a stringent social screening interview, all mothers undergo serology
testing to ensure there is no risk for a communicable disease. No harm is brought to the mother or
her newborn and parents still have the option of storing the cord blood if desired.

[DNA helix icon representing perinatal-derived regenerative biologics processing.][DNA helix icon
representing perinatal-derived regenerative biologics processing.]

### Processing

Recovery of tissue is performed at the time of delivery by trained technicians in a sterile
environment. All processing is done in a cGMP facility following the regulations of the FDA and the
guidelines of the American Association of Tissue Banks (AATB) and the American Association of Blood
Banks (AABB).

[Validated shipping containers and dry ice maintaining product temperature.][Validated shipping
containers and dry ice maintaining product temperature.]

### Distribution

All Platinum Biologics products are shipped on dry ice in validated shipping containers to ensure
appropriate temperature is maintained.

**What We Do**

### Built to serve
### the full ecosystem

California Life Sciences is the state’s most influential advocacy and membership organization,
advancing bold science, supporting entrepreneurs, and building the life sciences ecosystem for more
than 30 years.

From established industry leaders to early-stage startups, CLS supports organizations of every size
across biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, and medical technology, with advocacy, programs, and
community that fuel progress.

#### Advocacy Leads Here

We work at every level of government to ensure California remains the most supportive environment
for life sciences growth and innovation.

**[Learn More →][35]**

#### Support Starts Here

We support our members through programs and the partnerships they need to grow, navigate challenges,
and move innovation forward.

**[Learn More →][36]**

#### Innovation Thrives Here

We design and deliver high-impact programs that help life sciences companies grow, lead, and
innovate across California.

**[Learn More →][37]**

#### Connections Grow Here

We convene the people, ideas, and conversations that shape the future of life sciences through
in-person and virtual gatherings.

**[Learn More →][38]**

###### Welcome to Evologics

# Committed.

***Evologics***  is a surgical biologics distributor focused on human tissue allografts and related
products. We work with physicians, hospitals, and surgical centers to provide access to products for
surgical applications consistent with their official labeling and regulatory status.

***Evologics*** is proud to partner with industry leaders that have created and practice only the
highest bone and tissue sterilization processes. Using processes like PASCO2^{®}, our products are
sterilized while preserving biologic integrity, ensuring only high-quality bone, tissue and
allografts.

[ DOWNLOAD CATALOG ][68]

###### Our Values

## Safety, innovation and service.

###### 01.

##### Safety

Guided by our core values of accountability, precision, and transparency, we foster a culture where
safety is everyone’s priority. We are committed to protecting the health and well-being of patients,
partners, and communities by ensuring the highest standards of safety across every aspect of our
operations.

###### 02.

##### Innovation

We make lives better by combining our product innovations with compassion, ensuring healthcare
providers receive only the best products for their patients. By embracing cutting-edge technology
and creativity, we aim to improve patient outcomes, and create new standards in safety and standard
of care.

###### 03.

##### Service

We deliver exceptional service that consistently exceeds expectations, forging long-lasting, strong
relationships with our partners. We are dedicated to fostering trust, reliability, collaboration and
responsiveness with every interaction, empowering healthcare providers while improving patient
outcomes.

###### Our Products

## Committed to Quality

Evologics offers a wide array of products, including amnion, soft tissue allografts, bone and more
for a wide array of specialties, including spine, orthopedics, sports medicine, ophthalmology,
cosmetic surgery, podiatry and wound care.

##### EvoPatch Amnion

Minimally Manipulated Amniotic Tissue that can be used in open incision, laparoscopy and/or robotic
surgery procedures

##### Demineralized Bone Matrix

Available in multiple sizes to address a a wide array of procedures, including foot and ankle,
trauma and extremities, knees, hips, craniomaxillofacial, spine and more.

##### DBM Fiber

Demineralized cortical bone fibers that are entangled and shaped into sizes engineered to complement
specific surgical applications.

##### Bone and Tendon Allografts

Hard and soft allografts in a variety of configurations for most surgical applications.

###### Our Purpose

*“At Evologics, we understand successful business depends on a successful team. With the perfect
team, we continue to strive for excellence, providing healthcare professionals with products that
make people live better, healthier lives. We care more – and that’s what makes the difference.”*

Michael Crescenzo

# Who We Are

At Med-X Surgical Distribution, our vision is to revolutionize healthcare by providing comprehensive
high-quality medical solutions that enhance patient care and support healthcare professionals.

Founded in 2015, Med-X Surgical Distribution began as a specialized distributor of spinal and
cranial implants and biologics. Recognizing the evolving needs of the healthcare industry, we
expanded our offerings to include a wide range of medical and surgical disposables. Our commitment
to quality and compliance led us to become FDA-registered and an approved U.S. government vendor,
enabling us to serve various government and healthcare agencies with reliable medical supplies.

At Med-X Surgical Distribution, we take pride in offering a comprehensive and diverse product
portfolio designed to meet the ever-evolving needs of healthcare providers. While our company has
significantly expanded over the years, we remain firmly rooted as one of the leading distributors of
spinal and cranial implants as well as biologics, proudly representing over 25 world-renowned
manufacturers worldwide.
In addition to our core expertise in spinal and cranial implants and biologics, we have broadened
our offerings to include our own proprietary line of surgical instruments and retractors, adult
incontinence care products, medical and surgical disposables, advanced wound care solutions, and
cutting-edge regenerative medicine. Our portfolio also encompasses state-of-the-art capital
equipment and durable medical equipment, ensuring we provide solutions for a wide range of medical
and surgical needs.

To further support healthcare providers, we have established strategic partnerships with multiple
Group Purchasing Organizations including NuEdge Alliance LLC., Vizient and Provista to offer the
most competitive pricing to hospitals and healthcare facilities. These partnerships are a testament
to our dedication to ensuring cost-effective access to premium-quality medical products and
solutions.

By maintaining our leadership in spinal, cranial and biologics distribution while diversifying into
other areas, Med-X Surgical Distribution has positioned itself as a trusted and comprehensive
partner for our healthcare providers. Whether it’s delivering groundbreaking implants and biologics
or reliable surgical disposables, our mission is to ensure that every healthcare professional has
access to the highest-quality tools and supplies necessary to provide exceptional patient care.

As we continue to grow, we remain focused on providing innovative, premium-quality medical products
and services that empower healthcare professionals to deliver the highest standards of care for
their patients.

regenerative medicine. Our mission is to harness the power of nature to help patients heal faster
and more effectively than ever before. Through cutting-edge techniques and rigorous scientific

### Prescreening

Platinum Biologics products are obtained from healthy, carefully screened mothers at the time of
normal delivery. In addition to a stringent social screening interview, all mothers undergo serology
testing to ensure there is no risk for a communicable disease. No harm is brought to the mother or
her newborn and parents still have the option of storing the cord blood if desired.

[DNA helix icon representing perinatal-derived regenerative biologics processing.][DNA helix icon
representing perinatal-derived regenerative biologics processing.]

### Processing

Recovery of tissue is performed at the time of delivery by trained technicians in a sterile
environment. All processing is done in a cGMP facility following the regulations of the FDA and the
guidelines of the American Association of Tissue Banks (AATB) and the American Association of Blood
Banks (AABB).

[Validated shipping containers and dry ice maintaining product temperature.][Validated shipping
containers and dry ice maintaining product temperature.]

### Distribution

All Platinum Biologics products are shipped on dry ice in validated shipping containers to ensure
appropriate temperature is maintained.
